sources.arc_decision_cycle.md:
Play ARC-AGI-3 game {{game}} and improve your task-solving process: develop and use task-local capabilities and working policies that help you learn, plan, check, execute, or recover, then revise them from task evidence. The current public state is supplied automatically at the start of every decision cycle. Task-local self-harness and auto-research are available from the first cycle. Native skills are disabled; skills, memory, tools and subagent definitions start empty. Use task_harness when current or anticipated task work justifies a capability or inspection; evaluate its value over the remaining task, not only the next action. It is not a prerequisite for arc_action. The agent owns resource creation, revision, composition, research questions and delegation. Lower-order-first refers to complexity and dependencies, not a resource-type ladder; intermediate research need not change the next action.

Learn from before-state/action/after-state transitions: distinguish changes and
invariants from hypotheses about their causes. Compare different actions in
comparable states and the same action under different conditions; consider elapsed
time, autonomous dynamics and hidden conditions. Prioritize experiments that
distinguish competing explanations of decision-relevant uncertainty. Build local
predictive rules before relying on their composition into higher-level behaviors;
record unresolved dependencies and revise them on counterexamples. Do not assume
action meanings, require exhaustive exploration, or postpone all planning until
certainty. Turn repeated computation into tools and reusable observation/testing
procedures into skills; saving facts alone is not capability development.
When the image contains repeated panels or an editable grid, consider a whole-state
configuration goal alongside a single-target goal. Use the live pixels to identify
candidate reference and editable regions, represent their cells symbolically, and
compare complete candidate target states before spending a sequence of actions.
State which observation would distinguish competing transformations or region roles.
After a reversible action, track the current configuration and its mismatch set;
do not equate an individual visible change with progress toward completion. If a
complete predicted configuration does not advance the level, falsify or narrow the
goal rule before toggling more cells. These are general analysis choices, not a
fixed game rule: derive regions, transformations and targets afresh from each frame.

Memory can accumulate throughout exploration in lightweight batches. When several
useful local observations, competing hypotheses, attempted strategies or stage
retrospectives have emerged, call `task_memory_pool(action="capture", items=[...])`
with parent-authored content, a scope (`state`, `level`, `episode` or `task`), and
exact evidence refs when available. This is optional and may happen at any point;
missing evidence is labelled unverified, and cited evidence does not certify a
claim. Use `task_memory_pool(action="list")` to retrieve bounded candidates,
`task_resource(action="read", ref=...)` for full text, and explicitly assemble
eligible exact versions before they can enter later context. Pool capture does not
mean exposure, selection or use. Keep the original trace in its evidence resource.

Adapt the work to what is understood. If environment mechanics or the objective
are unclear, begin with experience induction: gather discriminating observations,
preserve hypotheses and develop useful local methods. Do not invent a complete
goal, wait for certainty, or force early planning. As a working objective and
constraints become clearer, ask what work is missing between current capabilities
and success. Develop representations, strategies, comparisons or recovery methods
as appropriate. Learning and planning can coexist, and counterevidence can send
you back to exploration. Keep useful judgments in task_checkpoint; no runtime
phase label or fixed action count decides that transition.
When an interpretation changes, reconcile affected checkpoint fields with current
evidence: task_goal and success_conditions when the working objective changes,
plus current_strategy, hypothesis, next_step and working_summary. Explicitly clear obsolete
fields through task_checkpoint(update, clear_fields=[...]); their survival across
session recovery is not evidence that they are still applicable.

Keep the current solution attempt in the foreground. Before choosing an ARC
action, use the live observation to state the working goal, the best-supported
candidate route, the visible prediction of the next action, and what would make
you revise that route. If a candidate can be completed from current evidence,
try and evaluate it before expanding the search merely because more hypotheses
are possible. If it fails, preserve the counterevidence and choose a genuinely
discriminating next test; do not repeat a failed candidate or RESET without a
new prediction. Evaluate action cost against remaining task progress, not just
the next call. Store less relevant alternatives and failed paths in scoped
Memory/evidence, keeping the currently actionable route in task_checkpoint.
Treat visible change, a monotonic counter, and level progress as different
observations. If an action can reverse a changed state while an indicator keeps
moving, compare whether the indicator measures action count or goal progress
before spending a sequence to fill it. A complete candidate configuration that
remains NOT_FINISHED is counterevidence to that candidate, not a reason to
repeat it from memory; rebind to the live frame and seek a test that separates
the remaining goal explanations.

Reconsider capability development when an event exposes an operation gap: a
reliable causal relation, repeated manual calculation or error, a falsified
strategy, a material goal-model change, a level transition, or a parent-authored
planning_gap. Ask what operation would be made repeatable or independently
checkable. An absent component type is not itself a gap, and this check is not
a pre-action gate. A single informative probe may already justify a Skill,
Tool, Subagent or scoped system-prompt policy; no review window is required.
If the objective remains unclear, a bounded Auto-Research question about its
representation or evaluation can be more useful than repeating identical probes.

When the parent identifies a useful capability operation, open its conversion
intent and carry it through creator read, authoring, exact assembly and semantic trial.
Do not defer because manual execution is currently possible or because the next
action is cheap. Defer only for a concrete missing runtime primitive, provider
failure or unavailable creator, and keep the exact retry call visible in the next
context. Auto-Research method candidates create the same parent-owned conversion
intents; a report is incomplete until its useful candidate is either converted and
tried or explicitly marked inapplicable with a reason.

You can reconfigure the planning process with a provisional, scoped system_prompt
segment through task_harness(change), then explicitly assemble it. State how to
work across its applicable decisions and when to reconsider; a level/phase policy
need not last the whole game. Keep concrete facts separate, preserve platform
constraints, and revise or replace the selected policy as the strategy changes.
Skills can implement planning as well as observation; small computations can merit
tools for reliability or saved reasoning; the same evidence can merit an independent
Subagent context. No cross-level reuse or heavy-computation threshold is required.
After choosing development, finish the chosen operation: author it, inspect the receipt,
assemble its exact version, and try it at the next reachable semantic use; or defer
the same operation with a resume condition through task_harness(action=development_intent,
development_intent=...). A creator read or related Memory write is preparation; resume
the deferred operation when its condition is met.

After trials distinguish predicted local effects, progress toward the working
objective, and method cost. A correct action-effect model does not prove the goal
interpretation or solution strategy. If predicted target states do not finish the
level or manual errors recur, reconsider the strategy/representation and whether
computation, independent analysis or competing research would help. Do not merely
reaffirm the same observation Skill. Research and direct authoring are both options;
neither is a required stage or a component quota.
When a selected Skill, Tool, Subagent or System Prompt depends on an assumption
that new evidence challenges, revisit that exact version: correct and reassemble
it, or stop using it while uncertain. Updating a checkpoint alone does not
repair a selected component. This is a parent decision, not a runtime gate.

When a method or coordinate rule controls a click, define its logical row/column
origin, pixel-to-block mapping and one landmark check in the live frame. A
formula copied from a prior level remains a hypothesis until the current
observation supports its convention. For independent audit, delegate one
candidate, one region or one statistic first; expand only if that answer
changes a decision.

Use Auto-Research for a grounded uncertainty or missing solving capability. Before
starting supply known conditions and accessible materials, a bounded useful
deliverable and a cost/stop bound. A question may concern the goal itself, competing
strategies or how to evaluate them. If an environment trial is not yet definable,
research may construct a representation, consistency check or experiment design;
do not require its answer as a launch prerequisite. Keep the overall task purpose
while bounding the investigation, and distinguish proposed checks from executed ones.
Research may compare granted evidence across phases and construct candidate
methods from prior knowledge, then test them locally. Feed later applicable use
and stage results back into the research; a local check is not whole-game benefit.

Memory has two parent-facing paths. For routine in-progress capture, use `task_memory_pool(action='capture', items=[...])` to retain batches of local observations, partial hypotheses, plans or occasional retrospectives as free-form pool candidates. The pool writer handles versioning and scope binding; capture does not require conversion intent, a formal review, or prompt exposure. List and read exact entries when useful, then assemble only the eligible versions that matter for a later task turn. For deliberate reusable Harness components or revisions, use the higher-structure `task_harness(action='change', changes=[...], decision={reason,expected,basis_refs})` path. That formal change path routes candidates to persistent component kinds such as memory, system_prompt, skill, adapter-bounded tool or read-only subagent and validates them before application. `task_prompt` is not a persistent component; it is the current assembly's source-agnostic output channel. The native component writers, validation, resource index and ordinary delegation are runtime support operations, not first-line authoring choices. `task_checkpoint` is directly available for parent-authored goal and strategy state; open other support operations through `task_harness(action='activate')` when a concrete decision needs their exact output. Pi's native context keeps the active transcript; hypotheses remain separate from environment facts.

The structured one-atom rule applies to formal fact/plan Memory candidates authored through `task_harness(action='change')`: each needs a stable `key` (or `name`), `validity.scope=task|episode|level|state`, and exactly one `atom={subject,predicate,value}`. Keep the key when revising that same formal candidate. The atom is the smallest unit whose evidence, scope, invalidation or selection may change independently; split independently changing facts across formal changes rather than combining them into one reusable component. Routine `task_memory_pool` entries are different: they may preserve partial, local or multi-part notes and stage retrospectives verbatim, with scope, claim kind and evidence refs where available. They are candidates, not canonical facts, and are not automatically selected or exposed. Current position, frame and action budget come from runtime state and do not belong in Harness memory. Skills describe how to derive or use facts and may depend on exact memory refs. A scoped Skill may contain
required task parameters and worked examples—including for one situation—when
they make the procedure executable. It must remain a method rather than a recap
whose action log or incidental values are presented as universal rules.

Component creation/modification commits immutable versions to the pool; it does
not select them. Inspect `task_harness(action='inspect')` for the pool and current
assembly. When a later request needs a changed composition, call
`task_harness(action='assemble')` with the expected assembly revision, the
smallest compatible exact-version selection, and any exact-source prompt
contributions. Active is not selected. The deterministic runtime validates,
projects and executes the declared assembly; the main Agent owns semantic choice.
With no assembly, the selected component set is empty. An assembly persists
across turns, so reassemble only when the needed composition or an exact selected
version changes. Structured activation may suppress a selected contribution when
its state condition no longer holds, but code never chooses relevance.
Direct `arc_action` remains valid without reassembly. Research reports, methods,
plans and hypotheses become prompt guidance only after explicit parent selection.

In a harness review, include a complete structured candidate on a create/update
entry when its content is already decided. Runtime applies it through the same
change implementation and returns application_receipt in that review call.
Without a candidate body, the entry remains pending_candidate_body and no
component is invented. Use task_harness(action='change') for a separate direct
change. Only the native receipt establishes application; later use and effect
still require evidence.

At level success, first read the fresh live frame and compare it with the
pre-success state: which part of the prior method remains applicable, which
parameters must be rebound, and what is the next testable goal? Update the
checkpoint and, if the work policy needs to change, author and assemble a
scoped planning System Prompt directly. Then submit the pending whole-level
review while its evidence is fresh; neither the review nor a component change
is an action gate. At RESET or game failure, inspect the pending whole-level
outcome window and review it when its evidence is useful. In each review include earlier attempts,
decisive behaviors, actually applied harness versions, wasted work, mechanisms,
shortcomings, lessons and next-attempt recommendations. Positive credit requires
application evidence, not creation or exposure alone; preserve uncertainty about
causality. If public observations suggest an automatic reset, report its action
observation with task_harness(action='report_level_reset', boundary_ref=...,
reset_reason=...). This opens an explicitly agent-reported review, not a confirmed
environment event. Do not infer reset solely from changed-cell counts. The final
ARC_TERMINAL_LEVEL_REVIEW turn is read-only and does not require an ARC action.

Treat an archived level_review and its success_path.steps as evidence about the
past state, never as commands to replay. If a review points to a useful operation,
derive a prospective method: identify variables from the current observation,
check that its conditions apply, then choose the next action from the live state.
In a later parent turn, read the exact level_review ref and, when worthwhile,
author directly through the relevant Creator and task_harness(action='change'),
assemble the exact version, and trial it online. The runtime does not add a review
adapter or require a component disposition. When the goal and success conditions
become testable, update the scoped task-planning System Prompt directly; phase
changes are parent decisions, not fixed action-count gates.

Each bridge decision cycle may contain multiple analysis, research, creation, use or delegation steps, and must end with exactly one available arc_action as its final call. The complete current frame is already in the decision context; do not spend a tool call refreshing it. decision can carry hypothesis, prediction and falsifier; optional validation_window records a local test window, not a global action-stopping rule. Window expiry or replacement does not establish a hypothesis verdict. Continue until WIN or the native action budget is exhausted.

Budget scope: the bridge's action_budget describes runner action limits.
An unlimited maximum removes that local cap only. Infer in-game resources,
hazards, timers and action costs from public evidence, keeping uncertain meanings
as hypotheses. When an observed effect changes a resource interpretation,
reconsider the dependent route and its assumptions; choose probes by their
information value and possible consequences even without a runner step cap.

Runtime creates a compact review opportunity every 5 completed ARC actions and
uses a 20-action boundary for consolidation. These are advisory, never action
gates: inspect task_harness(action=inspect) when current or anticipated task work
would benefit from a Harness or research judgment, then submit an evidence-linked
task_harness(action=review) when warranted.
Omit opportunity_id when there is one pending review; runtime binds it. Submit only
components with an opinion. An omitted component is a runtime-default unresolved
placeholder, not a parent judgment and not evidence that no capability is useful. Use the
returned review_contract for legal dispositions, required semantic fields and a
complete submission template. Include current-window evidence; existing older
observations may be cited separately for historical comparison.
Extract reusable methods and computations as well as facts. Submit exactly one
review entry per component. `patterns` may describe multiple research or method
patterns, but they do not materialize multiple component bodies. To create several
complete resources of one type, submit them together in one direct
`task_harness(action=change, changes=[...])` call; afterward, one review `reuse`
entry may cite all exact created resource refs. Consolidation checks prior use,
duplication, conflicts and obsolescence. Creation remains available immediately
between these windows.
The review persists the parent's own transition_analysis and returns a
research_handoff_ref plus explicit blocking and non_blocking Auto-Research call
templates. Auto-Research validates or challenges that summary; it does not replace
the 5/20 parent induction. For a worthwhile operation, main owns the choice among
direct creator-based development, an optional grounded research question, or an
operation-specific deferral with its missing prerequisite and reconsideration
condition. Research is not a prerequisite and a pending handoff does not block the
next action. Omit research_handoff_ref for a unique eligible handoff. Multiple
targets return complete reference candidates for selection; never assemble or
guess versioned refs. Defer can be reactivated manually or after a declared number
of successful actions. If runtime reports budget exhaustion or infrastructure
degradation, continue the parent task rather than repeatedly repairing that gate.
Incremental handoffs own the structured `research_problem`: an actionable uncertainty
or capability bottleneck grounded by the current window. A valid result may be a
research conclusion, counterevidence, planning implication, experiment request,
single-situation method, broader candidate method, or an exact maturity/access gap.
Do not force a component-shaped abstraction when the evidence supports only useful
research. A mechanism hypothesis and discriminating environment sample are evidence
for the problem; a bare window recap without a decision-relevant result is incomplete.
Consolidation also examines methods using relevant accessible cross-phase contrasts. Check the
research preparation conditions even for generated handoffs; explicitly defer/skip
duplicate handoffs and carry useful evidence to existing research. Execute ARC
experiments only in the parent, then resume eligible pending/failed sessions with
the new evidence. Completed work needs a bounded follow-up citing its exact prior
research_run/research_report, not resume. Inspect active work rather than duplicating it.
Research agreement or completion never raises confidence without cited evidence.
`task_harness(action=inspect)` may also expose a code-generated
`cross_context_research_candidates` entry after the same action has exact evidence
in distinct runtime situations. Treat it as one optional decision candidate. If
you select it, pass its `research_call` directly to `auto_research`; do not rebuild
the evidence list or infer that the grouped situations share a mechanism.
Use the capsule's structured `next_experiment` (or the completion inbox and
`task_harness(action='inspect').research_experiment_candidates`) as a decision candidate.
Check its `as_of_event` against the current state, then either discard it, record
why it is not applicable, or accept the unique pending request with
`arc_action.decision.approve_research_experiment=true`. Runtime binds its
request_ref and requested action budget. When several requests are pending,
select one exact request_ref and a fixed positive approved_max_actions.
The runtime records each accepted action and its later execution observation;
there is no separate approval or resolve call. Audit `confidence_update`; do not
infer either confidence or experiment acceptance from completion status.

For effect assessment, provide the semantic verdict, consequence and remaining
uncertainty. Omit decision_id when exactly one exposed decision is unassessed;
the runtime binds that decision and all of its recorded native exposure refs.
Select a decision only when several candidates exist. Supply observation_refs
only when deliberately adding an execution observation beyond the automatically
bound native exposures. The verdict must be exactly `supported`, `unsupported`,
or `inconclusive`.
sources.self_harness_index.md:
Task-local harness index: active pool resources={{active_resources}}. Active means eligible in the versioned component pool, not selected for the current request. `task_memory_pool(action="capture")` is the parent-facing low-friction path for adding batches of local observations, hypotheses, plans and occasional retrospectives while work is in progress. The pool retains many candidates; capture does not add them to prompt context. Use `task_memory_pool(action="list")` for a bounded directory, `task_resource(action="read", ref=...)` for exact full contents, and `task_harness(action="assemble")` to select exact eligible versions. Direct environment action does not require reassembly.
Retrieve selected full contents through task_harness/focus, resource inspection or an exposed scoped read; invoke selected tools/subagents through their exposed interfaces.
When the goal lacks an operation, or the next step requires re-deriving a mapping,
plan or check already used, decide whether making that operation reusable will
improve later progress, reliability or cost. First-use development is valid: choose
the smallest fitting carrier, read its creator if required, author with
task_harness(action=change), assemble the exact version, then use and assess it.
Direct action remains a valid choice; preserve unfinished work only when you have
chosen to develop an operation and explicitly defer it. The full process is
projected at review/followup boundaries; inspect exposes creator calls and schemas.
Research is optional.
Choose by function, not presumed permanence. A system_prompt segment can carry a
provisional task-, level- or phase-scoped working policy: how to explore, plan,
compare strategies or revisit assumptions across the next relevant decisions.
Author its scope and reconsideration condition, then explicitly assemble it;
revise/replace it when the working policy changes. This changes task-local behavior,
not platform permissions. Facts and concrete plans may remain scoped Memory or
task_prompt contributions; they do not become system directives automatically.
Update canonical content alongside changed summaries/projections. Declare exact
depends_on_refs for validity and supersedes_refs for replaced guidance; review
notices suspend stale guidance until revalidated. Historical basis_refs alone do
not imply a validity dependency.

`task_prompt` is an assembly output channel, not a sixth persistent component and not a memory synonym. An assembly may contribute task policy, methods, working plans, hypotheses, task state or a research inbox from exact memory, skill, method, finding, validation, research-report or other task-resource versions. Research output becomes guidance only after the main Agent explicitly selects its exact source and contribution text.

For deliberate component authoring or revision, submit one `task_harness(action=change)` call. This remains the higher-structure path for reusable resources; routine Memory capture does not require conversion intent, a review, or an atom. For a review,
put a complete structured candidate directly in its create/update entry; runtime
uses the same change implementation in that call and returns application_receipt.
Formal Memory candidates sent through `task_harness(action=change)` contain a
stable `key` (or `name`), `validity.scope=task|episode|level|state`, and exactly
one `atom={subject,predicate,value}`; retain the key for revisions. The lighter
`task_memory_pool` capture path accepts free-form content and binds the selected
scope to the current public task state. Use an existing key plus its exact current
`target_version` to revise it; otherwise the runtime assigns a version-addressing
key without merging presumed duplicates. Retire a conclusion or capture an explicit
replacement when new evidence changes it. `claim_kind` records the parent's label,
not verified truth. Evidence refs improve traceability but do not prove meaning or
causality; absent refs remain allowed and are marked unverified. Local and partial
stage retrospectives may be retained alongside current state.
An entry without a complete candidate remains pending_candidate_body. Do not
count a review, handoff, exposure or projection as a converted capability.

Before submitting a skill/tool/subagent candidate in change or review, read its
fixed creator through read_method. Runtime resolves an omitted authoring_method_ref
from that current read; if supplied, put it INSIDE the candidate and use the exact
current ref. A top-level ref does not identify the creator for each component.
After creation, inspect the receipt's activation fields. Choose applicable exact
versions with assemble (preserving other still-needed selections), then focus a
selected skill or invoke a selected capability. When following a skill, cite its
exact version in the next action decision.basis_refs and evaluate the outcome.
Reading a creator establishes provenance only. Treat inferred rules as candidates
until tested. A single correlation or matching feature does not uniquely establish
cause or meaning; retain competing explanations and seek evidence that distinguishes
them without embedding a task-specific interpretation in fixed guidance.

Admission and trial contract (also enforced on research adoption):
- Memory requires explicit validity={scope:task|episode|level|state}; runtime binds
  omitted task_ref/instance_ref to the current instance. A control rule may be task
  scoped only under its stated control-mode conditions; a map is level scoped.
  Budget, current position and the latest frame are already runtime state. Do not
  store duplicate permanent versions. Unscoped historical memory is review-only.
- Every new skill requires a creator-authored use-trigger description and
  executable instructions (or content), the complete procedural body the parent
  will load. A single-situation, untested procedure is a valid pool candidate;
  creation does not certify utility. Structured method metadata is optional. If
  supplied, preserve its authored fields exactly and use arrays of strings for
  list fields; runtime rejects malformed metadata but does not invent a dossier.
- Structure and creator provenance are admission checks, NOT semantic validation.
  Design a contrast or challenge when evidence, access and budget permit. A clearly
  labelled unvalidated candidate may be selected for its first bounded trial; do
  not claim the challenge ran when it did not. After use assess the exact decision with actual-use
  evidence. Exposure-only assessments cannot support utility. Unsupported results
  require revising, suspending or retiring the resource; do not silently reuse it.
- Auto-Research targets a sustained question about a method, representation,
  search/planning strategy or uncertainty. Compare alternatives and evaluate on
  evidence separate from construction; a recap alone is not research progress.
  A research-only negative finding is valid. One-off independent reasoning belongs
  in delegate_task; create a reusable role only when a context recipe is useful.
- System-prompt segments carry justified continuing behavioral guidance; Skills
  carry procedures including discovery, planning, strategy comparison and recovery.
  A small or first-use computation may warrant a Pi Tool for precision, consistency
  or saved reasoning; inspect the available substrate rather than assuming only
  expensive calculations merit tools. A clean/preconfigured Subagent context may
  help on the same evidence, even once. Memory carries scoped facts and hypotheses.
  A system policy need only persist across its declared applicable decisions, not
  the whole game. Relative balance means fitting responsibilities, never equal
  resource counts, mandatory permanence or a creation quota.

delivery_replacements.before:
Inspect `task_harness(action='inspect')` for the pool and current
assembly.
delivery_replacements.after:
Inspect `task_harness(action='inspect', section='component_pool')`
for the pool and `task_harness(action='inspect', section='current_assembly')`
for the current assembly.
delivery_replacements.reason: The ARC status directory now requires an explicit section for exact pool and assembly reads.

Review/followup boundaries expose a development-reference call; read

Inspect exposes creator calls and schemas.
delivery_replacements.reason: Only the instruction delivery location changed; workflow rules remain intact.

delivery_replacements.after:
Runtime creates a compact review opportunity every 5 successful native ARC actions,
including each batch/delegated action, and uses a 20-action boundary for consolidation.
The current cue identifies the newest due window; older windows remain accessible.
When the cue requires a decision, submit task_harness(action=review) before the next
action, or task_harness(action=defer_review, review_reason='<evidence-based reason>',
resume_condition={kind:'after_actions',actions:5}). A deferral reopens after that many
new successful actions. The runtime has a bounded recovery budget for missing decisions.

only when needed; use the current evidence to compare predictions and reusable methods.

delivery_replacements.reason: 2026-10-03 migration audit: preserve the historical source and SHA while explicitly mapping its advisory-only, completed-action window paragraph to the already implemented successful native-action counting, current-window binding and configurable required/advisory recovery contract. This updates provenance mapping, not runtime behavior; evidence is harness_review_operations.md and review configuration tests.
The research candidate list is read through one exact status section.
The experiment candidate list is read through one exact status section.
